title: Cloud threads follow the same model rules as local sessions

note: Local sessions cap subagents at Sonnet through settings.json env (CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_MODEL and CLAUDE_CODE_WORKFLOW_SUBAGENT_MODEL), the guard's subagent-model-cap ask, and agents/ model pins; cloud threads had none of these (checked Oct 26).
